blocks.text: TOKYO — Japan’s weather agency withdrew an erroneous alert for a magnitude 9.9 earthquake minutes after issuing it, apologizing for the warning that disrupted transport. The Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) had initially warned on Friday that a magnitude 9.9 earthquake occurred near the Kuril Islands, known in Japan as the Chishima Islands, setting off loud emergency alerts on millions of mobile phones. The JMA clarified later that a 6.9-magnitude quake occurred near Russia’s Kamchatka Peninsula at a depth of 160 kilometers (100 miles) just after midday.
